The Opportunity: More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as one of their biggest financial commitments, yet managing one still means paperwork, phone holds, and switching between apps that don't talk to each other.

Jerry .ai"> Jerry .ai built the first app to manage it all — insurance shopping, refinancing, safety, and repairs — and since launching in 2019, we've grown to over 5M customers. Every one of those customers comes to us already looking for a policy, through our mobile or web app.

As an Inside Sales Representative , your job is to take that interest and turn it into a bound policy, matching each customer with the right coverage from one of Jerry 's 55+ carrier partners.

Who you are: You have 2+ years of experience as a top-performing sales agent You can multitask and manage multiple competing priorities You are passionate about helping others How you will make an impact: Respond to inbound calls from prospective customers for personal line auto, home, motorcycle, and other specialty insurance policies Educate customers on insurance policy details such as coverage and pricing Prepare and bind quotes through our carriers Effectively problem solve and objection handle to remove barriers from the customer purchasing the policy with Jerry Provide attentive, high energy conversation with customers that show we are actively engaged in finding a policy that best fits each individual's needs Compensation and perks: Hourly wage: $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions (on target annual earnings: $100,000-$150,000+) We will pay for your P&C license (expected within 2 weeks after starting) Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match Ability to work remotely (we provide work equipment) Ongoing training and mentorship from our leadership team An outstanding portfolio of insurance carriers and products - we work with over 55 carriers to ensure we can offer our customers the best options for them This role includes flexible scheduling options, with the choice between a 5-day, 8-hour schedule or a 4-day, 10-hour workweek.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please note: Jerry .ai is only able to hire employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada.

We cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time. Jerry .ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits. About Jerry .ai Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s.

Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right.

That friend is Jerry . Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024.

We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond. We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto. Originally posted on Himalayas

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1 st , 2026, you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Institutional & Specialty divisions, Ecolab offers comprehensive chemical products and solutions to meet the needs of customers across the foodservice and hospitality industries as well as laundry, long-term care, education, corporate and government facilities.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and advisor to your customers. You will serve as the face of Ecolab, providing recommendations on advanced cleaning and sanitation processes and programs that drive a positive guest experience and create cleaner, safer, and healthier environments.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn customers’ ware washing & laundry systems and work hands‑on with equipment, learning installation, maintenance and safe use, ensuring that your customers’ facilities are fully operational and teams are properly trained
Gradually build confidence in identifying new opportunities and growing your territory providing customers with training, regular and emergency service and sales demonstrations
Coordinate sales and service activities with cross divisional peers and internal functions (e.g. Marketing Services, Customer Service).
Reach out to potential customers to secure new accounts, as you build Ecolab’s brand in your market

We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.
We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.
During your first 6 months with us, you'll be in the office five days a week. It's how we set you up to succeed early: hands-on coaching on live calls and constant access to your manager while you're learning the role. Once you've completed probation, you move onto our standard IRL-first schedule of three days a week.
Once you've completed probation, you move onto our standard hybrid schedule of 3 days a week in the office, 2 days from home.
How We Work
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond.

What is Leapsome?
Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams . Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.
Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone , and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.
Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!
Your Opportunity
We're building the SDR function at Leapsome from the ground up, and you'd be the third person on the team. That's a different job than joining an established sales org. There's no thick playbook waiting for you to follow. You'll help write it: what messaging works, which accounts to prioritize, what a good week actually looks like. If you want ownership over your process instead of a script to read from, this is built for you.
Our philosophy: we're AI forward. Automations handle the repetitive parts of prospecting, so you're not spending your day on manual busywork. Your job is to test what's actually working and add the human spark; the right tone, the right timing, the read on what a real person needs to hear.
Day to day, you'll research and reach out to HR and People leaders who could genuinely benefit from Leapsome, qualify them, and hand off strong opportunities to our AEs. We measure success in pipeline generated and meetings booked, and we're transparent about the career opportunities to grow your sales profession.
We want teammates who are curious about the people they're calling, competitive about hitting their number, and motivated to build something together rather than just follow the steps someone else laid out.

Research prospects and reach out with messaging built for their specific situation, not a generic template
Prospect into new accounts using a proven, repeatable methodology like calling, LI, email, or anything that gets the job done
Qualify outbound leads against a defined set of criteria
Partner with Marketing & RevOps on outbound campaigns to grow pipeline volume
Keep CRM accurate and current so the whole team can trust the data
Build real expertise in HR tech, and know where Leapsome wins against the competition

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you don’t meet every single requirement but feel excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply.

You treat a "no" as information, not a setback, and you keep going

* En tant que conseiller principal en cybersécurité, vous représentez Netrics de manière compétente et crédible sur le marché.
* Vous conseillez nos clients de manière globale sur des sujets tels que les stratégies de sécurité de l'information, la gouvernance, le risque et la conformité, la protection des données, l'ISMS, le BCM.
* Avec votre expérience, vous assumez des mandats d'interim CISO chez les clients avec des responsabilités stratégiques, organisationnelles et opérationnelles.
* Vous planifiez, dirigez et assumez la responsabilité des évaluations de sécurité, de risque et de conformité, y compris les évaluations de maturité, les analyses des écarts et les recommandations d'action adaptées à la gestion.
* Vous soutenez l'identification des leads ainsi que la création d'offres de conseil en cybersécurité en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre autonome des projets de conseil.
* Vous veillez à ce que les accords contractuels, les normes de qualité ainsi que les exigences d'efficacité soient respectés dans vos mandats clients.
* Au sein de l'équipe de conseil, vous vous impliquez en tant que moteur d'impulsions et d'innovation et favorisez le développement continu de nos services.
* La participation à des événements professionnels et conférences ainsi que la rédaction d'articles spécialisés au nom de Netrics complètent votre champ d'activités.
## Ce que vous devez apporter : ##
* Diplôme en technologies de l'information ou en gestion d'entreprise (université/haute école).
* Plusieurs années d'expérience avérée en tant que CISO, auditeur principal ou dans le domaine de la cybersécurité.
* Expérience de conseil approfondie et compétences stratégiques claires en réflexion et action avec une communication assurée au niveau C-Level et top management.
* Très bonnes connaissances en gouvernance, risque et conformité, protection des données, BCM et gestion des urgences informatiques.
* Connaissances approfondies des normes et cadres courants (ISO 27001, NIST, NIS2, BSI-).
* Des certifications telles que CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC sont un avantage.
* Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
## Ce qui fait de ce poste votre emploi de rêve : ##
* Vous faites partie de la famille Netrics, une équipe jeune et motivée dans un environnement très dynamique.
* Vous aimez naviguer en hors-bord rapide et participer à la détermination de la trajectoire.
* Des conditions de travail flexibles et modernes vous offrent beaucoup de liberté et de possibilités de création.
* Notre stratégie de croissance vous offre de nombreuses possibilités de développement personnel.
* La confiance et la reconnaissance sont la base de notre collaboration.
* Vous bénéficiez de plusieurs avantages sympas tels que des snacks et boissons gratuits, une allocation pour téléphone portable et une cofinancement de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou de votre place de parking.

An exceptional opportunity for growth . We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.

Permanent. Full-time.
Location
Fully remote.

If you pass our screening, we’ll invite you to a couple of interviews, designed to assess your motivation, ambitions, and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. **Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.
**Careers at Deloitte. **
Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects.

At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation.

With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing.

You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.
Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers.

## Job Description ##
